children: Ivory Coast's cocoa grind rose 21.3% year-on-year in August to 47,646 metric tons of beans, data from exporters' association GEPEX showed on Wednesday.
The total grind from the start of the 2025/26 season in October had reached 601,172 metric tons by the end of August, up 8.4% from 554,430 metric tons during the same period last season.
The GEPEX data covers six of the largest grinding companies, including Barry Callebaut
Ivory Coast has a total grinding capacity of 750,000 metric tons. It is the world's biggest cocoa producer and vies with the Netherlands for the spot of leading grinder.
